prompt: Moira runs our cooking club in Paisley. She sent us a shopping list for winter soup. We must buy three (kilo) of carrots and (some / any) fresh bread. There isn't (much / many) oil left in the cupboard, so please bring a bottle.
explanation_ru: После числительного three нужно множественное число kilos, в утверждении с неисчисляемым существительным bread используется some, а в отрицании с неисчисляемым oil — much.

prompt: Doris emailed the ferry office in Valletta because the evening boats have less benches for older passengers in the wind.
answer: Doris emailed the ferry office in Valletta because the evening boats have fewer benches for older passengers in the wind.
accepted_answers: Doris emailed the ferry office in Valletta because the evening boats have fewer benches for older passengers in the wind.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе (benches) используется fewer, а не less; выбор less — частая ошибка русскоязычных учеников.

prompt: Before sliding on the ice in Lucerne, Moritz read ___ from the guide.
explanation_ru: Существительное advice в английском неисчисляемое, поэтому с ним используют some advice, а не артикль an, форму во множественном числе или a few.

prompt: My neighbours are planting five garden beds in Hastings. 'Have we got (enough / too) dark soil for the peas?' one asks. 'No, and we need two new (box) for the tools,' I reply. We decide to borrow my (uncle / van) for the trip.
explanation_ru: Перед существительным soil в вопросе о достаточном количестве ставится enough, существительное на -x образует множественное число boxes, а принадлежность одушевлённому владельцу передаётся через 's (uncle's van).

prompt: Our rowing coach said the new team showed too few focus on the water.
answer: Our rowing coach said the new team showed too little focus on the water.
accepted_answers: Our rowing coach said the new team showed too little focus on the water.
explanation_ru: Существительное focus здесь неисчисляемое, поэтому нужно too little focus, а не too few focus.

prompt: Greet emailed her flute students in Maastricht to say that ___ must be dried after playing.
explanation_ru: Конструкция each of the + множественное число (each of the instruments) грамматически верна; every не сочетается напрямую с of или множественным числом.

prompt: Solene had a stressful baking test in a small shop in Tours. The baker handed her (a / the) wooden tray with flour, butter, and honey, but no measuring cup. She had very (few / little) time to mix the flour before the oven got hot. Luckily, the head (chef / advice) helped her stay calm and finish well.
explanation_ru: Поднос упоминается впервые (a wooden tray), с неисчисляемым time нужно little, а притяжательный падеж для одушевлённого существительного chef образуется с помощью 's.

prompt: Esther did not have enough printed music for fourteen new choir singers.
answer: Esther did not have enough printed music for fourteen new choir singers.
accepted_answers: Esther did not have enough printed music for fourteen new choir singers.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: неисчисляемое music верно употреблено с enough, а числительное fourteen — с формой singers.

prompt: Before filming started on the TV set in Quebec City, the manager gave us ___ to prepare.
explanation_ru: В сложном определении перед существительным (a five-minute break) слово minute стоит в единственном числе, а перед исчисляемым break нужен артикль a.

prompt: Our class is planning a picnic in the school garden. All the (child) want sweet grapes and cheese rolls. We don't need (some / any) cold drinks because we have apple juice. Let's buy four big (bottle) of juice at the corner shop.
explanation_ru: У слова child неправильная форма множественного числа children, в отрицательном предложении используется any, а после числительного four — bottles.

prompt: Thabo emailed his producer in Durban because the storm cut the power and the bad news about the lost interview were hard to share.
answer: Thabo emailed his producer in Durban because the storm cut the power and the bad news about the lost interview was hard to share.
accepted_answers: Thabo emailed his producer in Durban because the storm cut the power and the bad news about the lost interview was hard to share.
explanation_ru: Существительное news неисчисляемое и всегда согласуется с глаголом в единственном числе (was), а не were.

prompt: Could someone check? ___ left before the star show starts in Torun?
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым time используются how much и глагол в единственном числе is; частая ошибка — ставить how many или are.

prompt: Exams start soon, so my flatmates and I made a study snack list. We bought three (loaf) of brown bread and a jar of peanut butter. (Every / All) student in our flat drinks tea while reading at night. Even our (landlord / kettle) gets used ten times a day!
explanation_ru: Существительное loaf во множественном числе меняет -f на -ves (loaves), перед единственным числом student ставится Every, а принадлежность выражается через landlord's kettle.

prompt: After a dry autumn outside Cordoba, our team did not collect many rainwater in the barrels for the twelve tests.
answer: After a dry autumn outside Cordoba, our team did not collect much rainwater in the barrels for the twelve tests.
accepted_answers: After a dry autumn outside Cordoba, our team did not collect much rainwater in the barrels for the twelve tests.
explanation_ru: Слово rainwater неисчисляемое, поэтому в отрицании нужно much rainwater, а не many rainwater.

prompt: Paavo realised he did not drink enough water at work and felt tired.
options: Paavo drank a few water at his desk, so he felt tired.
Paavo drank a little water at his desk, which was plenty for him.
Paavo drank very little water at his desk, so he felt tired.
Paavo drank few water at his desk, so he felt tired.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым water нужно little в значении «слишком мало»; a little означает «достаточно», а few и a few употребляются только с исчисляемыми.

prompt: Denise and four colleagues are organising a farewell lunch in the break room. They placed plates, forks, and sharp (knife) on the long table. Neither of the two (manager) knows about the surprise gift. It was only a (five / minute) walk to the bakery for fresh rolls and cheddar cheese.
explanation_ru: Слово knife образует множественное число knives, после neither of the two требуется множественное число managers, а в определении a five-minute walk слово minute остаётся в единственном числе.

prompt: When Harriet complained about the dark lane behind her bakery in Winchester, the local police was quick to visit the street.
answer: When Harriet complained about the dark lane behind her bakery in Winchester, the local police were quick to visit the street.
accepted_answers: When Harriet complained about the dark lane behind her bakery in Winchester, the local police were quick to visit the street.
explanation_ru: Существительное the police всегда требует глагола во множественном числе (were), а не was.

prompt: Kieran warned rugby fans in Hamilton that ___ was worth the high price the seller asked.
explanation_ru: Для двух предметов с глаголом в единственном числе (was) используется neither of the tickets; both требует глагола were, а после of нужно множественное число.

prompt: I was nervous about changing trains at the huge station in Nagoya with two heavy suitcases. Thankfully, the bright platform signs and clear colour steps made the transfer easy. (The / —) information on the screens was so clear that I didn't ask anyone for help. Reaching my platform took less than a (four / minute) walk, and my (trousers / be) completely dry despite the rain outside.
explanation_ru: Речь о конкретной информации на экранах (The information), в определении a four-minute walk нет окончания -s, а парное существительное trousers всегда требует множественного числа глагола (were).

prompt: Two history researchers in Patras reported that the old archive room had too little dry air to protect the fragile paper maps.
answer: Two history researchers in Patras reported that the old archive room had too little dry air to protect the fragile paper maps.
accepted_answers: Two history researchers in Patras reported that the old archive room had too little dry air to protect the fragile paper maps.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: составные существительные history researchers, archive room и paper maps построены верно, а с неисчисляемым air правильно употреблено too little.

prompt: The cleaner in Hanover wants residents to lock the specific door of their shared laundry room.
options: Please lock the door of the laundry room after nine in the evening.
Please lock a door of laundry room after nine in the evening.
Please lock door of the laundry room after nine in the evening.
Please lock the doors of a laundry rooms after nine in the evening.
explanation_ru: Конкретная дверь конкретной прачечной требует определённого артикля the перед обоими существительными: the door of the laundry room.

prompt: Sanna wrote an honest review of the outdoor skating park in Oulu. The ice track was smooth, and there were (fewer / less) children in the park than usual. However, the warm shop ran out of hot soup by midday, leaving hungry guests with almost (no / none) hot food. Still, she loved the friendly staff and bought a warm (cup / coffee) instead.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым children используется fewer, перед существительным food ставится no (а не местоимение none), а ёмкость с напитком оформляется с предлогом of (cup of coffee).

prompt: Eeva wrote to the town paper about too many dust near the park.
answer: Eeva wrote to the town paper about too much dust near the park.
accepted_answers: Eeva wrote to the town paper about too much dust near the park.
explanation_ru: Существительное dust неисчисляемое, поэтому нужно too much dust, а не too many dust.

prompt: Although the hot summer near Jaen made the olive oil smell rich, Alvaro reported that ___ had cut this year's harvest.
explanation_ru: Существительное rainfall неисчисляемое, поэтому оно не имеет формы множественного числа и сочетается с very little, а не с few или many.

prompt: Ciaran is directing a sea adventure play on a tiny college stage in Waterford. Because the drama club has very (few / little) funding, the students couldn't buy real wooden planks. Instead, they built the ship's deck from thirty plastic (milk / box) borrowed from the canteen. Watching the actors pretend to sail on them gave the audience a good laugh, and the (students / creativity) amazed everyone.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым funding нужно little, в составном существительном milk boxes окончание -s получает только главное слово, а притяжательный падеж множественного числа на -s пишется как students' creativity.

prompt: A volunteer on a roof farm asks guests to close the gate.
options: Please shut the gate garden when you leave the roof.
Please shut the garden's gate when you leave a roof.
Please shut the garden gate when you leave the roof.
Please shut a gardens gate when you leave the roof.
explanation_ru: В паре существительных определение стоит перед главным словом в единственном числе (the garden gate), а известная крыша требует артикля the.

prompt: Two cousins are making wool mats in a bright room in Puebla. They don't have (much / many) green wool left for the last mat. 'Look at these full (shelf) of bright thread!' one cousin laughs. They add a rainbow border, and the (cousins / design) looks great.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым wool в отрицании ставится much, слово shelf во множественном числе превращается в shelves, а принадлежность двум кузенам обозначается апострофом после -s (cousins' design).

prompt: Wanda wrote in her email that there was so little shade along the gravel path that she gave up her two-hours walk and sketched indoors.
answer: Wanda wrote in her email that there was so little shade along the gravel path that she gave up her two-hour walk and sketched indoors.
accepted_answers: Wanda wrote in her email that there was so little shade along the gravel path that she gave up her two-hour walk and sketched indoors.
explanation_ru: В сложном определении с дефисом перед существительным (two-hour walk) окончание множественного числа -s не ставится.

prompt: 'Why does our smart speaker take so long to answer near the balcony?' I asked my flatmate. 'Our cheap internet offers poor speed, and (neither / either) of us wants to pay for a faster plan,' he replied. We only got (a / an) honest reply when we stood right beside the router. 'Even the (news / be) old when it finally plays!' I joked.
explanation_ru: Для отрицания «ни один из нас двоих» без частицы not используется neither, перед немой h в слове honest нужен артикль an, а неисчисляемое news требует глагола is.

prompt: 'I'm sorry to tell you that ___ had to stop baking our morning bread because of the local flour shortage,' Cormac said.
explanation_ru: Двойной притяжательный падеж строится с абсолютной формой притяжательного местоимения (a friend of mine), а не a friend of me или a my friend.

prompt: Katja invited a (friend / mine) and three other guests to dinner at her flat in Bremen. She texted clear arrival steps before we left home. 'Ring the second green bell, walk past the neighbours' bikes, and leave wet (umbrella) by the door,' she wrote. Her flat had (both / all) a warm kitchen and a cosy balcony overlooking the street.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «один из моих друзей» передаётся как a friend of mine, для нескольких гостей нужно множественное число umbrellas, а с парой предметов (and) употребляется both.

prompt: Dylan stops his walking group on the cliff to look at the one lighthouse above the bay.
options: Look at bright mist moving over white lighthouse above a bay!
Look at the bright mist moving over the white lighthouse above the bay!
Look at a bright mist moving over a white lighthouse above bay!
Look at the bright mists moving over white lighthouses above the bay!
explanation_ru: Участники прогулки видят конкретный туман, единственный маяк и залив перед собой, поэтому во всех трёх случаях нужен артикль the.

prompt: Borislav posted an ironic review of his hotel breakfast room in Sofia. The long restaurant table displayed ten (variety) of sweet honey and piles of warm cakes. However, when he asked the waiter for plain yoghurt at seven-thirty, there wasn't a single (pot / yoghurt) left in the kitchen. He wondered how a (four / star) hotel could offer so many sweet toppings but nothing simple to put them on.
explanation_ru: Существительное на согласную + y образует множественное число varieties, упаковка с содержимым связывается предлогом of (pot of yoghurt), а в определении a four-star hotel окончание -s не добавляется.

prompt: While cooking garlic soup in Funchal, Mariana accidentally picked up the full glass container of sweet liquid instead of vinegar.
options: She wanted to add a vinegar spoon, but she poured in an empty vanilla bottle.
She reached for the bottle of vinegar, but she poured in a bottle of sweet vanilla instead.
She reached for the vinegar's bottle, but she poured in sweet vanilla's bottle instead.
She reached for a bottle vinegar, but she poured in a sweet vanilla of bottle instead.
explanation_ru: Полную бутылку с содержимым называют bottle of vinegar / bottle of sweet vanilla; форма vanilla bottle обозначает саму ёмкость, а не содержимое.

prompt: Hazel tried a popular ginger biscuit recipe from an online forum in Bendigo. The author had written three pages of personal stories, but gave almost no useful (information / informations) about oven heat. Worse still, the recipe called for far (fewer / less) flour and far more dark syrup than any normal mix can hold. When Hazel opened the oven door, the biscuits had melted into one giant sticky sheet. She left a sharp comment warning (person) to halve the syrup before trying it.
explanation_ru: Слово information неисчисляемое и не принимает -s, с неисчисляемым flour используется less, а для неопределённого круга читателей используется множественное число people.
